Welcome to Hazlewood Castle & Spa
Hazlewood Castle is a historic castle hotel and wedding venue in North Yorkshire, located between York and Leeds.
Set within 77 acres of woodland, the estate offers comfortable accommodation, castle weddings, spa, dining, adventure activities and event spaces.
The Castle dates back to the Domesday Book and provides a unique setting for weddings, countryside stays and events in Yorkshire.

Rooms and Suites at Hazlewood Castle & Spa, Yorkshire
Each room is equipped with all the home comforts to make your stay with us at Hazlewood Castle the perfect relaxing experience, relax with a cuppa in your very own sanctuary and enjoy the artworks of resident artist Anita Bowerman .
All bedrooms are designed to reflect the Castle's historic character, complimentary toiletries, co-ordinated cushions and furnishing, plus duvets are in all rooms as standard.
Standard Doubles featuring all essential comforts, perfect for a short stopover. Superior Rooms, Suites and Master Suites offer more space and options for family stays. For special occasions opt for a 4 Poster room or Vavasour room, spacious and full of character.
The Castle
9 Spacious rooms and suites located in the main Castle with views of the gardens and gallops.
St Margaret's
Over the bridge in our pretty courtyard lays St Margaret's a selection of 12 quiet rooms perfect for families or guests with pets.
St Leonards
Through the secret door our 11 St. Leonard's rooms await, you can choose to rise with the sun or to watch it dip below the horizon in the evening with our sunrise or sunset rooms.
Autumn Spa Retreat
Enjoy a warming spa experience this Autumn
What's Included: Overnight Stay, Thermal Spa Experience, Two-Course Dinner in our Vavasour Restaurant, Full Yorkshire Breakfast
Prices start from just 235 per couple.
This offer is valid for stays September 1st until November 30th the ideal time to experience the rich colours and crisp air of the season in one of the most beautiful locations in Yorkshire

Room FAQs
CAN I BRING MY DOG TO STAY?
Read More
Yes, we do have a few dog-friendly rooms located in our courtyard St Margarets area.
We love dogs so responsible pet owners are welcome to bring dogs to Hazlewood Castle. When booking it is essential that you confirm the number of dogs that will be with your group.
Dog Policy
Important: Dogs left unattended in bedrooms must be secured in a crate. This is a compulsory condition of stay.
Dogs are permitted at Hazlewood Castle in St Margaret's accommodation only.
A charge of 15 per dog, per night applies.
We accept a maximum of two dogs staying per room.
To protect the property and ensure all guests enjoy their stay, the following rules strictly apply:
General Rules
Dogs must be kept under strict control at all times within the property
Dogs must be well-behaved and fully house-trained
Dogs are not permitted on beds or soft furnishings at any time
Owners must provide a suitable dog bed or basket
Any fouling in gardens or lawns must be cleared immediately
Dog hair must be thoroughly removed from rooms before departure
Unattended Dogs Strict Requirement
Dogs must never be left loose in a bedroom
If a dog is left alone in the room for any reason, it must be secured inside a crate
Failure to crate an unattended dog will result in additional cleaning or damage charges and may lead to the booking being terminated without refund
Dogs must not be left unattended elsewhere in the property
For safety reasons, dogs must not be left unattended in external areas as boundaries may not be fully secure
Public Areas
Dogs are not permitted in the restaurant or public rooms except the Flemish Hall and Library
We are open to other types of pets staying with you, please contact us directly to make the necessary arrangements for your stay.
WHAT TIME IS CHECK-IN & CHECK-OUT
Read More
You can check in from 3pm and check out is by 10.30am
CAN I ARRANGE AN EARLY CHECK IN OR LATE CHECK OUT?
Read More
Subject to availability the earliest check in is from 12pm and the latest check out is 2 pm, available at an extra charge.
Please contact our reservations team to arrange prior to your stay. info@hazlewood-castle.co.uk
CAN I USE HAZLEWOOD CASTLE FOR A PHOTOSHOOT?
Read More
Yes, we welcome photoshoots at Hazlewood Castle, subject to availability and prior approval. To ensure minimal disruption to hotel guests, weddings and events, all professional, commercial, promotional and organised photoshoots must be arranged in advance with our Sales Team. Unauthorised photoshoots may be asked to cease or relocate. Our photoshoot options can be found here
DO YOU HAVE FREE PARKING?
Read More
Yes in our resident's car park, we also have a visitors car park a short walk from the castle if the resident's car park is full.
DO YOU HAVE WIFI?
Read More
Yes we have complimentary wifi in the bedrooms and public areas.
DOES THE ROOM HAVE AN EN-SUITE?
Read More
Yes all our rooms have their own en suite, most have a shower over bath, however we do have a few with walk in showers.
DO YOU HAVE FAMILY ROOMS?
Read More
We do have larger rooms which can accommodate families, such as suite and master suites. They have sofa beds which can sleep 1 or 2 children depending on their age.
IS THE HOTEL ACCESSIBLE?
Read More
Being an 11th Century castle the hotel does face some challenges with accessibility. There are steps into the hotel, however we do have an outdoor platform lift which we can assist with to bring guests into the hotel.
Please take a look at our access statement for full details of the Castle
CAN YOU GET PUBLIC TRANSPORT TO THE HOTEL?
Read More
The nearest train station is Church Fenton which is 4 miles from the hotel, a taxi would be required to complete your journey.
The nearest bus stop is on the A64, a miles walk to the hotel.
DO YOU HAVE ANY RECOMMENDED TAXI COMPANIES?
Read More
Yes Calcaria (Tadcaster) 01937 835205 / Dougies (Tadcaster) 07795 086754 / Bridge Private Hire (Tadcaster) 01937 834126 / AB Cars Garforth 0113 2872222

About us
With loads of exciting things to see and do at Hazlewood Castle, there's bound to be something that takes your fancy.
From the thrills of quad biking and axe throwing to relaxing and pampering in Imagine Spa your stay with us can be whatever you want to make it.
Within easy reach are the Yorkshire Dales and Moors national parks, the cosmopolitan city of Leeds, and historic York for your retail therapy and hiking needs. Why not visit the Sam Smiths brewery or York races both are just a stone's throw away.
The Castle itself dates back as far as 1086 when it is first mentioned in the Domesday book, since then the hotel has had many different uses including a maternity hospital during the war, Carmelite monks retreat and the family home of the Vavasours. There is plenty of history to soak up and a tour with one of our knowledgeable guides is just the ticket to delve into the rich past of the Castle.
Ashdale Hotels
Hazlewood Castle is part of Ashdale Hotels, an independent collection dedicated to restoring and operating distinctive historic hospitality destinations. Today our focus is on creating memorable guest experiences through exceptional hospitality, beautiful surroundings and unique attractions, including Hazlewood Adventures and The Secret Forest.
The story so far...
It all began when on a beach in Sydney in 1998 an old school friend buried my wallet in the sand!
This peculiarity was further compounded by his promise that whatever money I had to buy a hotel he would match.
True to his word in October 2004 we bought the Kings Head Hotel, Richmond, North Yorkshire (in fact my wife Jo found it!) a hotel so full of character and characters
that we knew this was for us.
The group grew a little over the years, mainly thanks to the returning guests and we bought the beautifully restored Angel & Royal "the oldest Inn in England" the Queen Anne Dower House, Hazlewood Castle (a real castle) and Grants hotel, all grade I & ll listed buildings of great historic importance
Two other additions for you to enjoy are our Imagine Spas which epitomise elegance and luxury.
We have since sold the Kings Head, restored Grants Hotel to its original stunning terraced houses, and more recently sold the Angel and Royal and the Dower House Hotel during the Covid lockdown.
Our remaining Castle, hotel, outdoor activity centre, The Secret Forest and spa continue to offer our famous friendly service in the heart of Yorkshire.
We all enjoy working in such style as there is something very rewarding both for the staff and guests alike
Martin Wicks
Director

wikipedia.title: Hazlewood Castle
wikipedia.extract: Hazlewood Castle is a country residence, now a hotel, in North Yorkshire, England, by the A1 and A64 between Aberford and Tadcaster. It is one of the oldest fortified houses to survive in the whole of Yorkshire.
